about

ConnVAS is revolutionizing mobility by enabling real-time data sharing between vehicles, infrastructure, and road users. Our cutting-edge solutions prepare today’s infrastructure for tomorrow’s connectivity, creating safer and smarter roads. Our flagship technology, ConnVAS MAGIC, serves as an all-in-one edge computing solution, addressing diverse transportation challenges and transforming any crosswalk or intersection into a smart one. We offer solutions such as intelligent crosswalks, intersection safety systems, and comprehensive traffic analysis platforms. With proven success in live trials, ConnVAS is at the forefront of transforming road safety and efficiency, working closely with partners to integrate our technology into future transportation networks globally.

our vision

Our vision is to create a future where every road user, vehicles, infrastructure and pedestrians, seamlessly interact in a connected, intelligent transportation ecosystem that enhances safety and efficiency. We are committed to protecting the most vulnerable, such as pedestrians and cyclists, by deploying innovative solutions that redefine mobility experiences. As we move toward an autonomous and connected future, ConnVAS is enabling vehicles to connect with everything around them using V2X capabilities, ensuring a safer, smarter, and more efficient transportation environment from day one.
